desc: 一片式厚底凉拖，宽幅印花鞋带，冷雾几何展台加线框图标墙清新童趣风
leaf: 童趣印花一片式厚底浴室凉拖
name: 童趣印花一片式软底凉拖款

shots.intent: 三双不同配色的一片式拖鞋在冷雾几何展台上错落陈列，用清爽硬朗的体块感一秒区别于柔光家纺氛围，直接拉点击
shots.textZone: upper-left headline zone with a short accent pill tag and a small section number

shots.intent: 两行三列细线圆角方格把家长最在意的六点一次摆平，用图形语言承接首屏情绪并铺垫后面对比
shots.textZone: top headline zone, then six thin-line rounded-square tiles each with a short label

shots.intent: 高角度俯拍两双深浅配色成对陈列加一只素色礼盒块，给出送礼与成双的购买理由并锚定真实尺度
同一双鞋平放与轻折两种状态并置，直观解释柔软回弹的结构原理而不依赖任何材质或数字声明
shots.textZone: two short labels above each state plus a headline top-left

shots.intent: 斜掠光微距呈现宽幅鞋面的印花边界、热熔压边与一体成型质感，用做工细节支撑溢价
shots.textZone: one small annotation chip near the strap edge

shots.intent: 四张等尺寸微距方块配编号圆点，把外底纹、鞋带边、内床弧与厚度四层细节一次讲清
shots.textZone: headline top-left, each tile carries a #F2B233 numbered circle and a short label

shots.intent: 俯视平铺加右侧素色信息卡，把字段化的参数位与无数字选码示意排干净，降低决策疑虑
shots.textZone: right card column with five placeholder field rows and one number-free fit diagram

shots.intent: 五枚等距圆角色块各承一双同光位同尺度的鞋，比平铺色卡更像可选购的配色系统
shots.textZone: simple header top-center, one small thin-line chip beside each block

shots.intent: 极低仰视角让两双鞋压在色块棱边上收束气势，配短按钮引导加购收尾
shots.textZone: upper headline zone plus a bottom-center rounded CTA button

style.backgroundSystem: hard-edged geometric set: #F4F8F7 seamless cyclorama with rounded #CDE7E1 panels, stepped #E6EAEA plaster plinths and large rounded colour-block cards; one plain unprinted box block #E9DFCE as the only scale anchor; no fabric, no bedding, no rug, no foliage clutter
style.direction: clean playful kid-home moulded slide slipper ecommerce
style.iconSystem: thin-line rounded-square tiles with #2F4A52 outlines on #F4F8F7 and a #F2B233 tick mark, 12-pixel corner radius, equal stroke weight, low complexity; never filled circles, never glossy badges
style.lightingSystem: bright soft daylight studio key from the upper left around 6500K, even fill, crisp defined contact shadow that always grounds the product, faint rim highlight along the sole edge on side-profile shots
style.lockText: Campaign Style Lock: consistent clean playful kid-home moulded-slide-slipper ecommerce visual system across the entire image set, cool colour temperature; fixed palette of base field #F4F8F7, secondary panel #CDE7E1, ink text #2F4A52 and one accent #F2B233; bright soft daylight studio key from the upper left around 6500K with crisp defined contact shadows that always ground the product and a faint rim highlight along the sole edge; hard-edged geometric background system of rounded #CDE7E1 panels, stepped #E6EAEA plaster plinths and large rounded colour-block cards, with one plain unprinted box block #E9DFCE as the only scale anchor and no fabric, bedding or rug textures; matte acrylic sheet #DCEAE8 surfaces; geometric rounded sans-serif only, bold medium-weight Chinese headings in #2F4A52 with tight word spacing, small #F2B233 section numbers, short 12-14pt labels; thin-line rounded-square icon tiles with #2F4A52 outlines and a #F2B233 tick mark, never filled circles, never glossy badges; product always true to reference proportions with its wide single moulded instep strap, closed round toe, thick flat sole profile, visible outsole tread geometry and printed strap graphic kept exactly as in the reference, identical lighting and scale across colourways; no color palette changes, no mixed fonts, no random backgrounds, no inconsistent lighting, no mismatched icon styles, no material grade wording, no standard or certification marks, no numbers for weight or size, no medical claims.

style.presentationRules: product at true-to-reference proportions: wide single moulded strap across the instep, closed round toe, thick flat sole profile, visible outsole tread geometry and the printed strap graphic kept exactly as in the reference; identical lighting and scale across colourways; strap print never duplicated or re-arranged
style.surfaceSystem: matte acrylic sheet #DCEAE8, cool plaster plinth #E6EAEA, smooth seamless floor #F4F8F7, rounded card blocks #CDE7E1
